title: GlitchPatch: Repairing Glitch Tokens in Frozen Language Models via Local Retokenization
abstract: arXiv:2610.04399v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Glitch tokens are anomalous vocabulary entries that can cause large language models (LLMs) to produce outputs inconsistent with their inputs. Existing repair methods require access to model internals, making them impractical for frozen checkpoints. We investigate whether glitch tokens can be repaired outside the model by optimizing the input tokenization. An empirical study on BPE merge-rule deletion reveals that (1)deleting a glitch token's merge rule can fix a substantial fraction of failures, yet disrupting normal tokens sharing intermediate merge nodes causes the overall glitch rate to rise, and (2)different decomposition granularities yield non-monotonic fix rates while collateral damage on normal tokens grows monotonically. Motivated by these findings, we propose GlitchPatch, a repair framework for frozen language models based on local retokenization, consisting of two stages: the offline stage uses Behavioral Path Optimi

translated_title: GlitchPatch：通过局部重新分词修复冻结语言模型中的故障词元
translated_abstract: 故障词元（Glitch tokens）是词表中的一种异常词条，可能导致大语言模型（LLM）产生与输入不一致的输出。现有的修复方法需要访问模型内部结构，这使得它们对于冻结的模型检查点并不实用。我们研究了能否通过优化输入分词，在模型外部修复故障词元。针对BPE合并规则删除的实证研究表明：（1）删除故障词元的合并规则可以修复相当大比例的失败情况，但会破坏共享中间合并节点的正常词元，导致整体故障率上升；（2）不同的分解粒度会产生非单调的修复率，而对正常词元的附带损害则单调增长。基于这些发现，我们提出了GlitchPatch——一个基于局部重新分词的冻结语言模型修复框架，该框架包含两个阶段：离线阶段使用行为路径优化……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: GlitchPatch提出了一种基于局部重新分词的修复框架，无需访问模型内部即可在冻结的大语言模型外部通过优化输入分词来修复故障词元，并揭示了BPE合并规则删除中修复率与对正常词元附带损害之间的权衡规律。
en_tdlr: GlitchPatch proposes a local-retokenization-based framework that repairs glitch tokens in frozen LLMs externally by optimizing input tokenization, without requiring access to model internals.
